title: Stutter
rule: Every beat is drawn twice in a row, the second slightly altered, the errand already fading.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p79_stutter.py (plate, figures, balloons: build/p29_one_fixed_lens.py, p07_two_panels.py; brush: build/brushkit.py; figures: build/b1m2.py)

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: page 29's HANDMADE brush plate of the office printed in twelve tall panels (3 rows x 2 pairs), six beats E0-E5 each drawn twice side by side, pairs grouped by a narrow inner gutter
the second of each pair is a ghost pull: the plate printed again without re-inking (74 % ink, 3-4 px off register) with the figure redrawn slightly moved (step, arm, head tilt, her nod)
balloons with the four canon lines redrawn in both drawings of their pair (p29 brushed balloons, the shared pen hand)

stuttering captions under every panel ('He sets off..., He looks, looks up...'); the errand's own words (key, SERVICE door, 4:15, cupboard) printed word by word at an ink that falls panel by panel (1.0 -> 0.0) until the last pairs drop them
closing caption with the outcome at full ink; hand-ruled borders; folio '79 / Stutter'

events.E0: pair 1: memo on the desk, he sets off
events.E2: pair 3: he looks at the clock (4:10), answer
events.E3: pair 4: thanks; on toward the cupboard
events.E4: pair 5: cupboard open, key on its hook tagged SERVICE
events.E5: pair 6: pencil to chin, forgetting line; outcome caption

beat: the page printed panel by panel, each beat pulled twice: the inked pull, then its paler ghost beside it, while the errand words in the captions fade

self_check.check: A reader finds panels in near-identical pairs.
self_check.evidence: perceptually judged by the maker from the full-size page; blind reading pending

weaknesses: the stutter of the drawing (each moment drawn twice) can be read as the events happening twice (she asks twice); the captions frame it, nothing else
the fading errand words are pale grey at mid-page and may look like a printing fault rather than intent at phone width
panel crops cut the TICKET OFFICE board and the memo slip at the panel edge in several panels
the T of 'Ten' in the brushed balloon is light at this size
